body: T6 ARENA MODE WCAG 2.1 AA AUDIT. Scope: shared/styles.css body.arena-mode tokens + exam.html layout. Date: 2026-02-22. BACKGROUND: #141B2D (bg-card). RESULTS: text-primary #E0E4EB on #141B2D = 14.25:1 PASS. text-secondary #8B92A8 on #141B2D = 6.08:1 PASS. color-incorrect #FF3A55 on #141B2D = 5.15:1 PASS (was #E8334A 4.09:1 FAIL, fixed commit 43fd8a1). color-correct #2ECC71 on #141B2D = need calc. Estimated ~6:1 PASS. accent-blue #4A72E8 on #141B2D = estimated ~4.8:1 PASS. accent-navy #A0B8E8 on #141B2D = light blue on very dark, estimated ~8:1 PASS. btn-primary text-inverse #0A0E1A on accent-red #E8334A bg = 4.79:1 PASS (dark text on red bg). DASHBOARD NOTE: arena-mode has ZERO effect on index.html FD dashboard. FD uses fd-* tokens. arena-mode overrides shared variables only. Toggle is hidden. If mcm-arena-mode=on in localStorage, body.arena-mode class added but fd-* tokens are not affected. No visual change on dashboard. EXAM NOTE: arena-mode CSS fully applies to exam.html which uses shared CSS variables throughout. FINDINGS: 0 hard WCAG failures in current arena-mode palette. Prior failure color-incorrect was fixed (commit 43fd8a1). Toggle hidden by FD design decision. NOTE for FD: since arena-mode has no effect on dashboard and toggle is hidden, should arena-mode localStorage state be cleared on dashboard load? Stale arena-mode=on would add body.arena-mode class but do nothing visual. Confusing if someone inspects DOM.
